integrity: The analytic proof is self-contained. A separately implemented finite enumeration tested all integer parameter pairs with clock lengths 4 through 72 and independently computed the agent-level nominal-phase majority test at 81,330 instances; finite checks are not treated as a proof for unrestricted parameters.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the explicitly defined parallel flash-entry update, not the sequential after-entry pseudocode in the motivating paper.
Only a complete graph with two equal pre-synchronized groups, strict half-neighbor quorum, noise-free integer clock length C>=4 and flash width 1<=w<C.
The exact basin count concerns the C-squared group-phase sector and cannot be interpreted as a probability for freely initialized independent individual clocks.
Priority beyond the inspected published sources and indexed mathematical records is not fully established.
title: Exact two-cluster orbit census and nonmonotone synchronization in an entry-trigger quorum oscillator
